m1.typescript: m1 a mixed run gets every count both accuracies the segments and the first fix

e1.typescript: e1 an empty run has zero figures no segments and never meets the target

e2.typescript: e2 the run meets the target at exactly the target and not below it

e3.typescript: e3 a kind needs at least the minimum number of documents to be automated

e4.typescript: e4 a kind is automated at exactly the target accuracy and not below it

e5.typescript: e5 the figure is overstated only when the validated accuracy exceeds the all document accuracy by more than the gap

e6.typescript: e6 each shape counts documents once and an unchecked total counts only documents accepted as valid

e7.typescript: e7 the first fix follows the order of what costs most

e8.typescript: e8 percentages are whole numbers rounded half up

wrong-validated-denominator.defect: divides the correct documents by the valid ones and calls that the accuracy of the run

wrong-target-strict.defect: requires the accuracy to be above the target and not at it

wrong-segment-strict.defect: automates a kind only when its accuracy is above the target and not at it

wrong-min-n-strict.defect: automates a kind only when it has more documents than the minimum and not at least that many

wrong-gap-inclusive.defect: calls the figure overstated when the gap equals the limit

wrong-unchecked-any-status.defect: counts an unchecked total in documents that were never accepted as valid

wrong-fix-order.defect: puts the wasted retries before the invented values in the order of fixes

wrong-rounding-floor.defect: rounds a percentage down and not half up

wrong-empty-meets-target.defect: says an empty run meets the target
